job.job_description:
Design, develop, and deploy generative AI models and applications.
Optimize prompt strategies for various LLM use cases.
Architect and maintain scalable AI infrastructure on AWS.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into products.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in generative AI and cloud technologies.
5+ years of experience in software engineering or AI/ML development.
Strong expertise in Prompt Engineering and working with Large Language Models (LLMs).
Proficiency in AWS cloud services (SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, etc.).
Experience with Python and modern AI frameworks.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a remote environment.
About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Engineer to join our innovative team. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in prompt engineering and AWS to build cutting-edge generative AI solutions. You will work remotely and collaborate with a global team of experts.
